title: Message queues in 60 seconds
caption: Message queues in 60 seconds: how systems hand off work without waiting on each other.

scenes.say: A user signs up. You need to send an email, resize their photo, and update analytics. They shouldn't wait for all of that.

scenes.heading: Producers, a queue, consumers
scenes.say: So the app drops a message in a queue and answers straight away. Workers pick messages up when they're ready.

items.title: Durable
items.say: A worker crash doesn't lose the job.

items.title: Scalable
items.text: add workers when it backs up

scenes.text:
Hand it off.
*Someone will get to it.*
scenes.say: That's a message queue. Hand it off, someone will get to it.
